title: Re-fired crisis banner (tick 2401-3000) remains T1-only — the mandate's "no longer T1-only" covers only the resolve half
evidence:
demos/surge.dem:
# again and the engine re-fires @2401 (dedup is per activation: a resolved
# cause may re-trigger). The window ends @3000, base demand drains the backlog
capture at 30000ms
capture at 65000ms
capture at 119500ms
capture at 170000ms
Timing (harness/demo.odin): demolish_apply_tick = floor(119000*20/1000)+1 = 2381; rebuild draws @120000ms -> tick 2401; capture@119500 -> cap_tick floor(119500*20/1000) = 2390. Pixel probe: 65000ms shows the banner; 119500ms and 170000ms banner regions are empty and byte-identical to each other (0 diff px). No capture exists in the 120050-150000ms re-fire window.
detail: The 119500 bracket pins the resolved (banner-gone) frame only. The banner re-appearing after the @2401 re-trigger has no blessed frame, so a render regression there passes all four surge T2 goldens.
recommended_fix: Add `capture at 125000ms` (tick 2500, mid re-fire window) to surge.dem and bless the banner-on frame to pin the re-trigger visually.
